gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC keeps its curves open and its ascenders low. Autour One goes the other way, a bold display face with a clear channel leading into every round letter and almost no step from capitals to lowercase. A slightly larger body size would give the plain sans more room.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada reads sturdy and a touch bulky, its c forms never closing into rings. Autour One, bold and round with no thin-to-thick shift, sits above it; nudging the body size up gives those chunky lowercase proportions space.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Autour One draws every stroke with the same bold thickness, so no hairline ever gets lost at small sizes. Noto Sans Siddham adds a large central band and an s with ends hanging wide.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Round, loud and unfussy. Autour One looks drawn with a single tip, each glyph simple and bold, while Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick dark stripe of lowercase through every line; a little extra body size lets its curve endings keep their distance.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads big and open on a screen, thanks to a sizable x-height and curves with wide, unclosed mouths. Autour One, bold and round with no heavy-to-light shift in a stroke, announces things up top, and Noto Sans Soyombo then carries the text underneath.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Autour One looks drawn with a ruler and compass, each bold line smooth and unvaried. Noto Sans Sundanese follows with open-mouthed e crossbars and capitals barely taller than the lowercase, so the pair's strongest quality is its tidy, mechanical clarity.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in every curve. Autour One is bold and round with no visible difference between its upright and sideways strokes, and over a long passage the body's short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies would feel open and friendly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-syloti-na: Autour One gives its lowercase n an arch exactly as heavy as its stem, a bold, uniform build. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri then settles into a long read with short ascenders, tall x-height and an a whose lower bowl breathes.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, with small letters dense like bundled cable. Autour One is the showpiece, each stroke holding one thickness like a drawn cable, while Noto Sans Syriac Western does the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Autour One's lines are tubelike and constant in weight, bold without a single hairline. Noto Sans Tagalog lets the middle zone dominate each line, and over a longer passage its generous curve gaps would keep the texture easy on the eye.
